text: 我不piao，就算合法了也一定不会去
en: I don't do piao, and even if it were legalised I definitely wouldn't go.

text: 我以前肯定是赞成非法的，但现在，不是了，没别的，纯粹是感觉很多人的道德比卖的还低了，不如划片地让她们营业吧，也许还能拉高女性的道德平均值（没别的意思，就是现在的劫匪都穿婚纱了，还不如让她们卖）
en: I used to be firmly in favour of criminalising it, but now, not anymore — nothing else to it; purely I feel a lot of people's morals are lower than those who sell themselves, so we might as well zone them off and let them operate; maybe it would even raise the average moral standard of women (no offence intended — it's just that nowadays even robbers are wearing wedding dresses, so we might as well let those women sell).

text: 有点难评，广东pc…
en: A bit hard to judge, Guangdong pc…

text: qj案，显得上面的答案有点过于稚嫩了，我们还是多探讨下怎么扩大死刑范围吧，这些都治标不治本了
en: The qj case makes the answer above seem a little too naive; let's discuss more about how to broaden the scope of the death penalty — all this only treats the symptoms, not the root cause.

text: 事实上现在大陆地区卖淫已经是半合法化了。
en: In fact, prostitution in the mainland is already semi-legalised.

text: 组织卖淫顶格可以判无期，但对卖淫的处罚很轻，顶格就是拘留十五天，罚款五千块。
en: Organising prostitution can draw a maximum sentence of life imprisonment, but the punishment for prostitution itself is very light — at most fifteen days' detention and a five-thousand-yuan fine.

text: 卖淫的在乎吗？
en: Do those who sell themselves care?

text: 不在乎的。
en: They don't.

text: 歇业十五天，出来再卖就是了。
en: Close up for fifteen days, then come out and sell again — that's all.

text: 五千块，一二线城市长得但凡过得去的，两三单就回来了，一个下午都不用。
en: Five thousand yuan: in first- and second-tier cities, any who are even halfway decent-looking earn it back in two or three clients, not even needing an afternoon.

text: 所以目前大陆法律对于卖淫行为根本没有什么震慑力——唯一有点作用的可能就是留案底，当然集美们怕的也不是留案底本身，毕竟这些人里有志于考公考编的也是少数，主要还是怕耽误未来回老家嫁人——现在讨论卖淫应不应该合法的问题完全没有意义。
en: So at present mainland law has basically no deterrent effect on the act of prostitution — the only thing with any effect is probably the criminal record; of course what the girls fear isn't the record itself, since among these people few aspire to sit the civil-service or public-institution exams — it's mainly the fear of delaying their eventual return home to marry — so debating whether prostitution should be legalised is utterly meaningless right now.

text: 不合法也没耽误人家卖。
en: Not being legalised hasn't stopped them from selling either.

text: 建议看看天涯神贴，国家为什么要控制性资源获取的难易程度
en: I'd suggest reading the legendary Tianya threads on why the state controls how easy or hard it is to obtain sexual resources.

text: 据我的办案经验，和与几个当事人以及帽子叔叔的沟通来讲，其实现如今的制度还算是比较合理的。
en: Based on my case-handling experience and my communications with several parties involved and the police, the current system is actually fairly reasonable.

text: 总结来讲，就是用案底和拘留的高风险去对冲向下自由的高收益。
en: To sum up, it uses the high risk of a criminal record and detention to offset the high returns of downward freedom.

text: 失足妇女群体没有你们想的那么肮脏恐怖，当然也没有多好，相当多做此类行业的，都是有孩子的已婚、离婚妇女，或是穷乡僻壤里来的招娣小妹，做这行的原因也很简单，来钱快不辛苦，加上自己本来也就不值什么钱了（至少在她们自己眼里是这样），做这个也没什么太大的损失。
en: The fallen-women community isn't as filthy and terrifying as you imagine, but of course they're not exactly wonderful either. Quite a lot who do this line of work are married or divorced women with children, or little Zhaodi sisters who've come from remote backwaters. The reason for doing this trade is simple: the money comes quickly and it isn't hard, and on top of that they themselves aren't worth much anyway (at least in their own eyes), so doing this involves no great loss.

text: 她们普遍低学历，智商也不高，许多还背着各种各样的债务，找不到什么好工作，在家呆着不仅自己闲，还被家里人嫌弃，于是就在自己某个朋友的带路下出来做，真正和她们接触过（不是像几个高赞一样交易过）你就会发现，为什么她们会被塔定性为人民内部矛盾，而不是敌人，她们中的绝大多数并不邪恶，只是像良子一样的奸懒馋滑而已，和穷凶极恶的诈骗犯、杀人犯有着本质区别。
en: They are generally poorly educated and not very bright either, and many are saddled with all sorts of debt; unable to find decent work, staying at home leaves them idle and earns them the disdain of their family, so they go out and do this led by some friend. If you've truly been in contact with them (not merely transacted with them, like a few of the top-voted commenters), you'll understand why the state characterises them as a contradiction among the people rather than enemies. The vast majority of them are not evil — they're just wicked, lazy, greedy and slippery, like Zi Liang, fundamentally different from vicious fraudsters and murderers.

text: 失足对她们而言算是一种向下自由，也是为数不多的向下自由。
en: For them, falling is a kind of downward freedom, and one of the few forms of downward freedom there are.

text: 同理，对于嫖客来讲，招嫖亦是一种向下自由，并且能够享受到解决需求的高收益。
en: By the same logic, for the clients, soliciting is also a kind of downward freedom, and one that lets them enjoy the high returns of having their needs met.

text: 相比于结婚、包养等合法手段，用招嫖解决需求不仅快捷、简单而且相对廉价，门槛极低，绝大多数的嫖客也不是什么坏人，就是憋的慌而已。
en: Compared with legal means such as marriage or being kept, using soliciting to meet one's needs is not only quick and simple but relatively cheap, with an extremely low threshold. The vast majority of clients aren't bad people either — they're just frustrated, that's all.

text: 这俩人群都不是人民的敌人，他们仍然还是相信秩序，相信你情我愿、公平交易的，如若不然，这俩就一个去搞性诬告，一个去强奸了。
en: Neither of these groups are enemies of the people; they still believe in order, in mutual consent and fair exchange. If it were otherwise, one side would file false sexual accusations and the other would commit rape.

text: 所以想要禁绝，那必然是不可能的，不仅执行层面就做不到，而且也不利于社会维稳。
en: So wanting to abolish it entirely is necessarily impossible — not only is it infeasible at the level of enforcement, it is also unhelpful for maintaining social stability.

text: 卖淫活动虽然不缴税，但用一种另类的方式解决了大量底层女性的就业问题，也是一种底层男性向底层女性转移支付的方式，总体来讲是稳定的。
en: Although prostitution pays no tax, it solves the employment problem for large numbers of bottom-tier women in an alternative way, and is also a form of transfer payment from bottom-tier men to bottom-tier women; overall it is stable.

text: 同时，也给那些没能力娶妻、包养的底层男性提供了一个发泄的窗口，相当于一个缓冲区，让憋疯了的底层男性不至于失去理智，客观上也能降低性侵或其他恶性案件的发生率。
en: At the same time, it provides an outlet for those bottom-tier men who have no means to marry or keep a mistress, functioning as a buffer that stops frustrated bottom-tier men from losing their reason, and objectively can lower the incidence of sexual assault and other vicious crimes.

text: 但如果完全放开，那更是不可能，向下自由必须要有代价，没有代价那所有人都会向下走，没人向上整个社会就得垮。
en: But if it were completely liberalised, that would be even more impossible. Downward freedom must carry a price; without a price everyone would go downward, and if no one goes upward the whole society would collapse.

text: 对失足妇女来讲，合法化卖淫就意味着市场供给直接爆炸，不仅没有了高风险所提供的溢价，大量的竞争者也会瞬间将利润抹平，同时也会造成其他正常行业的劳动力短缺，最后造成从业者既辛苦又不来钱。
en: For the fallen women, legalising prostitution would mean the market supply exploding outright; not only would the premium provided by high risk disappear, a flood of competitors would instantly flatten profits, and it would also cause labour shortages in other normal industries, ultimately leaving practitioners both toiling hard and not making money.

text: 如果是正常行业，还可以改行，但卖完淫的失足妇女再想从良向上走，已经是不可能了。
en: If it were a normal industry, one could switch trades, but for a fallen woman who has sold herself, trying to reform and move upward is already impossible.

text: 至于对男性来讲，那就更加让塔感到恐怖了，招嫖全面合法化、廉价化意味着什么，就无需多说了，并且在没有了任何法律风险甚至道德负担后，不仅是底层男性会更进一步拥抱失足大军，中产、甚至富人阶层也会逐渐融入，全体男性一起向下走，男性集体失去了任何被榨取超额价值的可能，这对社会生产力的破坏将会是根基级别的。
en: As for men, that is even more terrifying for the state to contemplate. What the full legalisation and cheapening of soliciting would mean need not be spelled out; and once there is no legal risk or even moral burden at all, not only would bottom-tier men embrace the fallen-women ranks more firmly, the middle class and even the wealthy would gradually blend in too, all men going downward together, men collectively losing any possibility of being extracted for surplus value — the damage this would do to social productivity would be foundational.

text: 以上问题叠加14亿人口级别的裂变反应，是个什么概念诸公可以尽情想象一下。
en: Stack the above problems on top of a fission-reaction-scale effect across 1.4 billion people, and you gentlemen can imagine the concept freely.

text: 所以卖淫合法化，在欧洲那些已经去工业化的金融服务业国家可能还有点搞头，但在中国这个每年卖一万亿美元工业品的世界工厂实行，纯属痴人说梦。
en: So legalising prostitution might have some merit in those deindustrialised financial-services countries in Europe, but implementing it in China, this world factory that sells a trillion dollars of industrial goods a year, is pure fantasy.

text: 至于性病、黑帮问题和早已摇摇欲坠的生育率问题，那就更不用提了。
en: As for sexually transmitted diseases, gang problems and the already teetering birth rate, there's no need to even mention those.

text: 所以，最好用的制度就是如今逐渐演化出的现状，让卖淫和招嫖都存在被拘留和留案底的风险，通过高风险去对冲高收益，让男女双方的向下自由都存在相当的代价。
en: So the most useful system is the status quo that has gradually evolved: letting both selling and soliciting carry the risk of detention and a criminal record, using high risk to offset high returns, so that both men's and women's downward freedom carries a considerable price.

text: 然后再通过以窝点举报为主、主动侦查为辅的执法方式，让失足妇女和嫖客一直都存在被抓的可能性，可能性虽然不算高，但只要敢大规模泛滥，或是长期把卖淫嫖娼当个事业做，墨菲定律发力就必然被抓。
en: Then, through a law-enforcement approach that mainly relies on reporting of dens and secondarily on proactive investigation, keep the possibility of arrest constantly present for fallen women and clients. Although the probability isn't high, so long as anyone dares to operate on a large scale or treats prostitution as a long-term career, Murphy's Law will take effect and they will inevitably be caught.

text: 这样，类似于古时在赈灾的时候给白米里摻沙子，用来防止富裕人家前来蹭粥喝，这套制度设计的目的也是为了避免能干正经活的女性大规模下海，避免能结婚买房的男性大规模招嫖。
en: This is like in ancient times, when sand was mixed into the white rice during famine relief, to stop wealthy families from coming to freeload the congee. The purpose of this institutional design is likewise to prevent women capable of proper work from entering the trade en masse, and to stop men capable of marrying and buying homes from soliciting en masse.

text: 而需求最强烈的那一批人依然能无视风险继续安装，让最没出路的底层女性能接收到转移支付，也能让快憋坏了的底层男性不心生邪念。
en: Yet those with the strongest demand can still ignore the risk and carry on, letting the most desperate bottom-tier women receive the transfer payment, and also keeping the bottom-tier men who are about to burst from harbouring evil thoughts.

text: 这是这几十年来无数试错所摸索出来的趋同经验，也是脚踏实地实践出来的制度，所以如果想实事求是、不抖机灵地反驳合法化的问题，按我的思路来即可。
en: This is convergent experience groped out through countless trials and errors over these decades, and an institution practised down-to-earth. So if you want to refute the legalisation question with a matter-of-fact attitude and without being a smart aleck, just follow my line of thinking.
